name: Agent Tunnels
description: A platform that enables coding agents to collaborate across different companies/organizations, creating tunnels for agent-to-agent communication.
community_quotes: Show HN post from 2026-08-07
Agent collaboration between companies

name: Graphify
description: Turns codebases into queryable knowledge graphs using AST parsing. Integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI as a /graphify skill to reduce token usage.
community_quotes: Less token use for Claude Code
Local deterministic AST parsing, no vector store

name: stem
description: A Claude Code workspace that interviews you, then builds itself around your actual work. Includes skills, memory, projects, and scheduled agents that maintain themselves.
community_quotes: Builds itself around your actual work
Self-maintaining scheduled agents

name: ai-raccoon
description: Gives AI agents a memory that outlives the session. Features local-first SQLite per project, hybrid search, workspace sandboxes, and optional cloud sync.
community_quotes: Give AI agents a memory that outlives the session

name: antigravity-cli-vs-code-extension
description: VS Code extension that opens Antigravity CLI (agy) in a dedicated terminal panel, bringing AI-powered coding assistance into the editor similar to Claude Code and Codex.
community_quotes: Bringing AI-powered coding assistance into your editor

name: Cairn
description: A cross-platform desktop Git client that combines repository administration, terminal-based work, and AI coding-agent workflows in one application.
community_quotes: Combines Git, terminal work, and AI coding-agent workflows

name: hud-mode
description: A compact heads-up display for coding agents. Shows instrumentation while the agent works and the answer when it stops. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.
community_quotes: Instruments while it works, the answer when it stops

name: wife
description: A local, persistent, and auditable memory layer for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. Ensures coding agents remember context across sessions instead of treating users like strangers.
community_quotes: Your coding agent stops treating you like a stranger every morning
Persistent memory layer for multiple coding agents

name: CoordClaw
description: A multi-agent system that runs AI like a one-person company. Uses management theory with teams defined in natural language and collaboration driven by message loops.
community_quotes: Multi-agent system that runs AI like a one-person company
Auditable work logs

name: AgentBridge
description: A self-hosted, AI-readable foundation for Vibe Coding business tools. Lets AI and developers write business-specific domain logic while the platform handles shared behavior.
community_quotes: AI-readable foundation for Vibe Coding business tools

name: debroid
description: An autonomous, headless Android debugger designed specifically for AI coding agents. Can inspect runtime memory, set breakpoints, and debug live applications.
community_quotes: Autonomous Android debugger for AI coding agents

name: axern
description: Open-source sandboxes designed for AI agents, untrusted code execution, and durable services.
community_quotes: Sandboxes for AI agents

name: Trajex
description: Indexes thousands of Claude Code, Codex, and Pi JSONL sessions into SQLite for millisecond queries. Coding agents can query past sessions while users browse through an app interface.
community_quotes: Query past Claude Code, Codex sessions by your agent
Browsable by you through an app

name: SkillForge
description: A skill package manager (like npm) for AI Coding Agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Local-first, model-agnostic, and MCP-native.
community_quotes: Skill package manager for AI coding agents
Local-first, model-agnostic, MCP-native

name: LongHorizon Harness
description: A framework for running AI agents across desktop apps and CLI for extended periods with task state preservation. Integrates with Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw.
community_quotes: Run AI agents across desktop apps and the CLI for extended periods
Fresh-context execution, durable verified state
